# Skill: deliverables-index-maintenance

## Job
Keep `deliverables/INDEX.md` an accurate, alphabetically sorted one-line-per-file listing whenever the contents of `deliverables/` change, so a reviewer can see what the folder holds without opening every file.

## When to use
Whenever a task creates, renames or deletes a file under `deliverables/` (including when the ticket's acceptance criteria only mention the file itself). Also use it when `deliverables/` has content but no `INDEX.md` yet.

## Steps
1. Read `deliverables/INDEX.md` if it exists (`read_file`); if it does not exist, create it with the heading `# Deliverables index` and the line `One line per file, sorted by file name.`
2. For every file you add, add exactly one line of the form `- <file name> - <purpose in a few words>`, using the bare file name (no directory prefix) exactly as it appears on disk.
3. Keep the list sorted by file name (case-insensitive), not by the order you touched files; re-sort the whole list when you insert in the middle.
4. For a rename, edit the existing line in place and re-sort; for a delete, remove its line.
5. Ignore `.gitkeep`; do not list it.
6. Leave the rest of the folder untouched: this skill is bookkeeping only, never move or rewrite deliverable files.

## Tools
`read_file` to read the index, `write_file` to create it, `edit_file`/`multi_edit` or `apply_patch` for small in-place changes, `glob`/`list_dir` on `deliverables/` to confirm what actually exists.
